title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update (PC) ✈️ VHHH Hong Kong + 18 New Airports & Fresh Sceneries!
description:
It’s March 15, 2026, and your MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update (PC) is here! This week’s PC list is all about airports and sceneries (no aircraft drops shown in this PC table), so the must‑have pick is easily iniBuilds VHHH Hong Kong International, especially when paired with the Hong Kong City Landmarks for those skyline arrivals. 😍

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 MSFScenerybuilders: CAH3 Courtenay Airpark Airport (Great pick for low-and-slow GA hops)
🛫 NMG Simulations: FASD Saldanha-Vredenburg Airport (Coastal vibes and regional ops)
🛫 NMG Simulations: FATP New Tempe Airport (Perfect for smaller regional routes)
🛫 IsmaBerk: GMFO Angad Airport (Unique destination for your route map)
🛫 Fly 2 High: KBLI Bellingham International Airport (Awesome for Pacific Northwest flying)
🛫 MSFScenerybuilders: KBTM Bert Mooney Airport (Classic GA + regional traffic potential)
🛫 MSFScenerybuilders: KEKO Elko Regional Airport (Great stop for US cross-country legs)
🛫 MK-Studios: KEYW Key West Airport (Iconic island approaches and vacation energy)
🛫 UK2000 Scenery: KJOT Joliet Airport (Handy Midwest operations base)
🛫 UK2000 Scenery: KPSM Portsmouth Airport (Nice coastal US airport for short hops)
🛫 Devinci: KROC Rochester Frederick Douglass Airport (Solid regional hub option)
🛫 MSFScenerybuilders: LCEN Ercan International Airport (Perfect for Mediterranean routes)
🛫 KiwiFlightSim: NCRG Rarotonga International, Cook Islands (Absolute tropical must-fly)
🛫 KIWIFLIGHTSIM: NZHK Hokitika Airport (Scenic New Zealand flying at its best)
🛫 Realworld Scenery: PADQ Kodiak Airport (Rugged weather ops and epic approaches)
🛫 iniBuilds: VHHH Hong Kong International (Big-hub realism and heavy traffic vibes)
🛫 MSK productions: WMKL Langkawi International Airport (Beautiful island gateway)
🛫 Shunts Scenery: YBSU Sunshine Coast Airport (Stunning coastline—great for VFR/IFR)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 dfflyerdirect: Detroit Midtown (Urban VFR eye candy and skyline exploring)
🌆 Burning Blue Design: United Kingdom Solar (Adds a fresh visual layer to the UK)
🌆 iniBuilds: VHHZ iniBuilds Hong Kong City Landmarks (Makes Hong Kong arrivals pop!)

If you enjoyed the update, drop a quick like, subscribe for weekly MSFS 2024 Marketplace coverage, and comment below: which airport are you flying firstHong Kong heavies, Key West island hops, or a Cook Islands getaway? 👇

Thanks for watching and happy flying… ✈️ See you in the skies!
